item.title: Science - Ideas
item.description:
Be curious about the universe Physics - Cosmology, Quantum Computing, Information Theory, Space, Mars, and the big strange questions.

Book - Calling ET

  • Solve Physics Problems with Python
    • Python - Solar System Simulator
    • Built-in Earth-Mars launch calculator
    • Breakthrough Prizes (Listen)
    • Research Inhomogeneous/Timescape Cosmology
    • Galaxy Simulator with Time-Dilation Calculator Idea - Time Dilation Game
      • Local cluster sim (nearest stars)
      • Develop/Build something to take humans to another star
    • Idea - Time Dilation Game
      • Python script for calculating time dilation?
      • Game Plot Idea - Use the game to re-tell the story of how we “figured out” the nature of reality/gravity
        • You could create a similar game for teaching and/or figuring out quantum mechanics.
        • Turn “Flatland” into a video game - has someone already done it? Experience existence as a 2D, 8 bit version of yourself, then change gameplay as you add dimensions (like Spore evolving from single-cell to intergalactic)
      • Idea of sitting near a black hole and watching the universe race by, like a forward time machine
        • Futurama episode
        • Sci-fi short story?
        • What benefit to someone who did it?
          • “Living the slow life” - a bit like a retirement home or as a lighthouse keeper.
          • Not “losing time” like you see in “Interstellar”, but an active decision to step into a much slower stream while the rest of the universe screams away without you.
          • There’s something here about the nature of time and conciousness, but I can’t quite feel it yet.
            • Godel - Time doesn’t exist
            • Libet - Creating our reality without time
          • There’s also something there about being next to something huge and heavy too - that the closer you get, the larger the effect, but you mustn’t cross the invisible event horizon.
          • The idea that you need to be orbiting the black hole at near the speed of light to stay outside the event horizon too - double effect of velocity and promixity (Special and general relativity)
            • Where does an orbiting space station draw it’s power to do this? From axial jets? Does it need to draw power at all? Is there an acceleration?
            • Lorentz Contraction - what does it look like from outside? A dot? A 2D line?
            • Spagettification - how do you manage the G-forces experienced by the space station keeper?
              • If you have some sort of gravity dampener, does that impact relativity & the experience of time? Does the shape of space-time have an impact on conciousness?
              • Really asking difficult questions about what gravity is?
              • Can we get around this with water dampening? Does this even work if there’s a constant gravitational acceleration? At what point does tissue breakdown, even in water?
              • Idea of the body being kept perpendicular to gravitational axis to reduce Spagettification - slight gravity differential between nose and back of the head (shape of the head after extended stay)

Quantum

Write quantum physics and holographics book?
